about.text: On March 3, 2020, 82% of the voters in the City of Oxnard (the “City”) voted to approve a ballot measure known as the Oxnard Government Accountability and Ethics Act (“Measure B”). Measure B included, among other things, per candidate contribution limits and aggregate contribution limits for municipal elections.
